ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the schematic diagram of population growth and changes in the natural population growth rate in Shanghai, China. <image1> Starting from 1993, what is the main reason why Shanghai's natural population growth showed negative growth while the total population continued to rise?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First look at the graph: in the graph, the horizontal axis is 1993-2003, the left side represents the total population quantity of Shanghai, and the right side represents the natural population growth rate. It can be seen that, starting from 1993, the natural population growth rate was always a negative value, but the total population quantity instead continuously rose from about 12.95 million people to around 13.42 million people. Then reason further: change in total population = natural population growth + mechanical population growth. Since natural growth was negative while the total population still continued to rise, this shows that mechanical population growth was positive and relatively large in magnitude, that is, the in-migrating population was greater than the out-migrating population, offsetting the natural decrease and driving the increase in total population. Therefore, the main reason is the in-migration of a large population.

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中横轴为1993—2003年，左轴表示上海市总人口数量，右轴表示人口自然增长率；从1993年起自然增长率数值均为负，而总人口曲线/柱状数值总体由约1295万人上升到1340多万人。再读题：题目要求解释“自然增长为负但总人口持续上升”的主要原因。运用人口数量变化公式：总人口增长=自然增长+机械增长，机械增长主要指人口迁入迁出差额。既然自然增长为负仍能使总人口增加，说明迁入人口多于迁出人口且足以抵消自然减少，因此答案为大量人口迁入。
